profile: Operator with both an advisory and a hands-on operating track record, who turns strategy into the KPIs, dashboards, workflows, and accountability systems that let mission-driven organizations scale. Ran a 140-person workforce and social-enterprise division with full P&L accountability for an $80M portfolio, owning an employment model for justice-impacted adults, earned-revenue lines, and HR for hundreds of program workers; reversed a $1M operating deficit into a 13% surplus. Created a clean-energy workforce training program from inception, piloting before rollout and reaching 92% certificate completion, and built a coalition with Stanford Innovation Lab, KPMG, NYPA, and city and state partners. Designed an AI career-launch program and built SkyNet, an AI workflow now in daily use. Leads finance and people functions as a fractional CFO, and partners with CEOs and Boards on planning, organizational design, and growth. MBA.

bullets.text: Created and led an 18-month NYPA clean-energy workforce training program from inception; piloted the model before full rollout; 92% of enrolled participants completed training and earned a certificate.
Built a coalition of city and state agencies, elected officials, academic partners, Stanford Innovation Lab, KPMG, and NYPA around training delivery and employer pathways.
Designed a Citi Foundation proposal for an AI career-launch program linking AI learning, workforce preparation, and employment support, with measures for skills, employment, wages, and retention.
Built and piloted SkyNet, an AI-supported workflow for research, evaluation, document preparation, and engagement tracking, now in full daily use.
Design KPI dashboards, forecasts, and outcome measures that give leaders and funders a real-time view of performance.
Lead financial planning, budgeting, treasury, liquidity management, and cash-flow forecasting for client organizations across nonprofit, private, education, and public-sector settings.

jobs.title: Vice President, Business Development & Social Ventures

bullets.text: Held full P&L accountability for an $80M portfolio; led financial and operational oversight of a 140-person, multi-program division.
Owned an employment and workforce-development model integrating job readiness, placement, and wraparound supports for justice-impacted adults.
Reversed a $1M annual operating deficit and delivered a 13% operating surplus through cost restructuring, financial controls, and revenue optimization.
Ran HR for a workforce program overseeing hundreds of workers, including hiring, supervision, compensation, and employee relations; wrote the HR manuals.
Led 12 direct reports across finance, grant stewardship, and operations through weekly operating reviews, individual check-ins, and clear performance standards.
Negotiated and structured $10M+ in new government, institutional, and corporate contracts.
Implemented a redesigned ERP-based warehouse management system, improving processing efficiency 60% and data visibility.
Renegotiated vendor and logistics agreements, reducing costs 35% and improving margins.
Directed financial controls, billing, and compliance for NYCHA and NYC Department of Homeless Services contracts.
Developed operational and performance-improvement strategies for $50M+ organizations and major brands.
Served as financial architect for a $200M national banking-development initiative, supporting capital planning and financial structuring.
Built accounting, governance, and operational infrastructure for an international NGO serving children in Haiti.
Founded and scaled a multi-location business from a $5K investment to a $1M enterprise; delivered 33% YoY revenue growth and an 11% margin improvement.
Built HR, payroll, benefits, and training infrastructure for a team that grew from 4 to 60 full-time employees.
